name: Air pollution peak at evening rush
description: The Twin's clock jumps to 17:30: traffic emissions raise PM2.5 across the city. On the mock, AIR-06 (zone J) also climbs to 30 µg/m³ (an industrial release) and falls back.

expected.twin: Evening traffic; PM2.5 follows the emissions.
expected.brain: Computes the risk score per zone; above 100 closes the zone's car parks, under 70 for 3 readings reopens them. Below 100 it only watches.

how_to_verify: Top bar pollution; map arrow AIR-06 → LOT-06; logs/PO01-*.jsonl. On the live Twin the scenario adds a release on zone J's air monitor (AIR release, device API: it rises, holds and fades over 150 s), so zone J passes 100 and its car park closes, then reopens; traffic alone keeps the air under the alert level. Every closure carries its score in the reason.
trigger: python scenarios/run.py PO01   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)
